name: street-fighter-v-php-online-sales-paused
note: رسمي: Capcom JP (@StreetFighterJA, 27 Oct 01:00Z): PS4 and Steam versions of Street Fighter V have online features unavailable during security hardening related to PHP; offline content still playable; temporary maintenance under way; PS Store and Steam sales stopped in stages until the fix is done. Footage: SFV Champion Edition launch trailer (Steam). Sound: our bed; every stretch of the trailer carries fighter call-outs (speechcheck 2-18, 30-52, 86-102, 108-124 s); only the end slate (118-129 s) is clean and it is shorter than the Reel.
lines:
